pr_title: Replace Fixer API with QC API for GDAX FX conversion rates
pr_body:
#### Description
The Fixer API has been replaced by the new QC Pricing API in the `GDAXBrokerage`.

#### Related Issue
Closes #2383 

#### Motivation and Context
Remove the dependency on an external service.

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
A live GDAX algorithm using BTCEUR (which requires the EURUSD conversion rate) has been tested locally.

- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)

issue_context.title: GDAX Brokerage Relying on Fixer
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Users of LEAN would be able to use the GDAX brokerage or the QC API to get the current price of FX assets.

#### Actual Behavior
Relying on rate limited external brokerage service.

#### Potential Solution
Review the GDAX brokerage for an easy option; if none; replace the fixer call with a QC-API/prices call. 
https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Api/Api.cs#L592

#### Reproducing the Problem
https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Brokerages/GDAX/GDAXBrokerage.Messaging.cs#L95

review_comments: What do you think if the `ApiPriceProvider` constructors check _`api.ApiConnection.Connected` and if false throw?
Other `IApi` implementations might not have an `ApiConnection` property, I think it would require a new method in the `IApi` interface, e.g. `IsInitialized`
